# v3.29-dev

## Fixed

- **Importing a training file no longer wipes your Legacy settings.** If the file you imported didn't happen to include a **Legacy** column, every row it touched had its legacy marker — and its replacement list — silently cleared. An import that looked like it was only updating the columns present was quietly undoing work elsewhere.

  Legacy, Replacement and Ignored are now resolved against what is already stored: a column that isn't in your file leaves that value exactly as it was, and only a column you have actually mapped can change it. A blank cell in a mapped column still means "not legacy", as before, and changing a training's type to one that can't be legacy still clears it.

## Changed

- **Removed the Ignore button from the main catalogue rows.** It sat right beside Edit on a row that opens when you click it, which made it far too easy to hit by accident. Ignoring is still available where it belongs: on each entry in the **"needs attention"** list, and on the **Full Title** page alongside the other group-wide actions, where it applies to every training title at once and can be undone with **Restore**.
